headline: Volatility Index Rose To 20.85 From 16.46
narrative: The Cboe Volatility Index rose to 20.85 from 16.46. The index prices 30-day options protection on the S&P 500, so a higher print means money in that pipe is paying more for downside hedges. The S&P 500, the cash index that pipe hedges, fell to 7650.68 from 7744.06.
author: jordan
